name: Rachel Browne
bioAdditions: WikiTree's profile quotes Alva Tuttle (1968, p. 279) for Rachel's children with James Tuthill: Rachel (1715), James (1717), Elizabeth (1719), Daniel (1721), Mary (1725), Jonathan (b. 6 Oct 1727), Mehitable (1728/9) and John (1730) (S1). The list includes Daniel of Goshen (will 1761) and James Jr. of New Windsor (will 1756), whose wills fit. WikiTree gives her a death of 1738, unsourced. Her father Jonathan Browne is given on WikiTree as d. 19 Aug 1710 at Orient. The Salmon Record has a 'Jonathan Brown died' on 18 Sept, apparently 1704 by its sequence (S2). This could be a different Jonathan Brown, but the conflict should be checked.

conflicts.foundValue: Salmon Record: 'Jonathan Brown died' 18 Sept, in the 1704 run of entries
conflicts.assessment: Unresolved; there may have been two Jonathan Browns in Southold. Check Southold probate.
